title: Isto É Zico: Zico no Kangaeru Soccer
native_title: イスト・エ・ジーコ ～ジーコの考えるサッカー～
overview:
What Zico has left behind is not simply his many soccer records and theories of technique - (omitted) - the very way Zico has lived as a person is his message to us.

- From the text

A multimedia soccer guide built around the thinking of Brazilian legend Zico. Watch video lessons and read his advice on technique, training and coaching, presented in three modes.

- Zico Mode: get to know the real Zico and his views on the game, including words for coaches
- Basic Mode: go back over the fundamentals, such as juggling, dribbling, trapping and passing
- Level Up Mode: polish more advanced techniques

ジーコが残してきたもの、それは単にサッカーに関する数々の記録や技術論だけではない――中略――人間・ジーコの生きざまそのものがわれわれへのメッセージである。

――本文より
